desc:
Ur egg is on the dino menu! HURRY - build your fort, set traps, and get ready for the stampede!

[How To Play]
🪤 Place traps and turrets to defend your egg!
🦖 Fight off waves of hungry dinos!
💰 Earn cash for every dino you stop!
⚔️ Open crates to unlock epic weapons!

🥚 Protect the egg at all costs!
